annotations.title: Did this company cut jobs because of AI?

description: Did a specific company cut jobs because of AI? Returns the register's verdict for that company (explicit, mixed or blamed), the roles it disclosed vs the roles counted as AI-attributed, and every recorded event with the employer's own words and source. Accepts a company name such as 'Klarna' or 'Salesforce'. If the company is not in the register, says so and what that does and does not mean.

company.description: Company name, e.g. 'Klarna', 'IBM', 'Salesforce'. Partial names work.
